rows.text: copies 32-byte rows from `rcx` (stride `rdx`, unaligned loads) to `r8` (stride `r9`, aligned stores), with the row count in the fifth (stack) argument: it copies four rows per pass and subtracts 4, repeating while the count is at least 4 (signed; the first pass runs unconditionally), then copies single rows until the count reaches 0; `xmm6` and `xmm7` are saved and restored

for 16 rows sums `psadbw` absolute byte differences between the 16 aligned bytes of each `rcx` row (stride `rdx`) and the 16 bytes at offsets 0, 1 and 2 of the matching `r8` row (stride `r9`) into three word accumulators, adds each accumulator's two 64-bit halves and stores the three sums as dwords at `+0`, `+4` and `+8` of the fifth (stack) argument

reads eight 16-byte rows of words from `rcx` at a stride of twice `rdx` bytes, applies three stages of `paddw`/`psubw` butterflies, transposes the 8-by-8 word block with word, dword and qword unpacks, applies three more butterfly stages and stores the eight result rows to `r8` `+0` through `+0x70`; `xmm6` to `xmm9` are saved and restored
tail-jumps `002E5B00(rcx)` when byte `+3` of `rcx` ANDed with `0xE0` equals `0x60`, otherwise returns
